name: Hiruda Kiriko
source:
Seemingly a delinquent on the outside, she's actually an earnest, well-raised girl on the inside. Hilda is athletic, but on the contrary, she doesn't do really well at studying.

Hilda is a straight-man type of heroine who headbutts people when reacting to their silly remarks. She's foolish on a different genre from Tyler. She's not very good at horror in general, and because of this Leona often makes fun of her by scaring her.

She went to the same elementary school as Tyler and Leona.

Favorites: Chatting with Leona, selfies
